caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is a pair of brass-colored metal candle wick trimmers with two large circular handles on the right side, similar in shape to scissor handles but more ornate. The handles have small pointed feet at their bases. Extending to the left, the tool has a flat blade-like edge ending in a pointed tip with another rounded foot beneath for stability. Near the center, there is a raised, rectangular box or compartment with a hinged lid for collecting the trimmed wick, and a circular disc feature is present beside it. The entire composition uses shades of gold and brown to highlight the metallic material and to create depth and shadow, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Wick Trimmer
